Eli (Docs): Heads up  opened a docs PR for SDK snippet corrections and a short migration note re: the embeddings param rename. Need a merge slot before next doc cut. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4408

Priya (Release): Cutoff Fri 18:00 UTC. What stage is CI preview in?

Eli (Docs): Preview failed due to heading anchor collision and a lint error in the JS snippet. preview-bot shows: 'build failed: anchor collision on #migration, snippet-lint: unknown method embed()'

Chris (Eng): The snippet needs conversion to `client.embeddings.create`. Also check frontmatter for `aliases` to avoid anchor collision.

Eli (Docs): Fixed snippet and added unique anchor `#migration-embeddings-1-4`. Re-ran preview.

preview-bot: build started for PR #4408  job run r-7792

Marta (Product): Quick note: please add a short compatibility table indicating which runtime versions support the new embeddings pipeline.

Eli (Docs): Added `supported_runtimes: ["r2+", "r3 (recommended)"]` in frontmatter and a tiny compat row.

preview-bot: build r-7792  lint passed, linkcheck passed, preview URL: https://docs-preview/internal/4408

Priya (Release): Approvals needed: docs + eng + product. Also request to mark PR `merge-on-slot` and schedule it for Thurs 09:00 UTC. If approved and CI green, we can merge before cutoff.

Chris (Eng): LGTM. Approving.

Marta (Product): Approved with a small nit on wording in the migration bullet. Eli will fix.

Eli (Docs): Wording nit fixed and pushed. All approvals present.

Priya (Release): Added `merge-on-slot` label and scheduled Thurs 09:00 UTC. Release notes entry set to internal-only for now. Remember to keep the example behind `draft` if product wants to hold visibility.

Eli (Docs): We will not set draft; the example is general fix-only and ok to go live. Queueing merge for Thu slot. Will merge if no issues.

preview-bot: PR #4408 status: approvals=3, checks=passed, labels=[merge-on-slot]

Eli (Docs): Merged at 2024-11-07T09:00:01Z. Closing thread.
